The verbatim excerpt was extracted PROGRAMMATICALLY from the raw HTML bytes (the field--name-body container) and compared character-for-character with the text drawn in the PDF (cross_check). cross_check.method: Every page's content stream was decompressed and its text layer read in page order. After the page-2 header (section number and title, identical to the HTML <h3>) and the 'LAST AMENDED 12/5/2024' stamp, the PDF text was compared character-for-character with the HTML-derived body text, whitespace and non-breaking spaces removed on both sides. Result: identical, including every #defined term# marker and the paragraph labels (a), (b), (c), (1), (2), (3), (d), (1), (2), (3), (4) (the HTML draws those labels from list markup only; the PDF prints them).

verbatim_excerpt:
23-344 Additional rear yard modifications

R1 R2 R3 R4 R5 R6 R7 R8 R9 R10 R11 R12

In all districts, as indicated, the #rear yard# requirements set forth in Section 23-342 (Rear yard requirements) and the #rear yard equivalent# requirements of Section 23-343 (Rear yard equivalent requirements) shall be modified as set forth in this Section.

(a) Within one hundred feet of corners

In the districts indicated, no #rear yard# shall be required within 100 feet of the point of intersection of two #street lines# intersecting at an angle of 135 degrees or less.

(b) Along #short dimension of a block#

In the districts indicated, whenever a #front lot line# of a #zoning lot# coincides with the #street line# of the #short dimension of a block#, no #rear yard# shall be required within 100 feet of such #street line#

(c) Beyond one hundred feet of a #street line#

In all districts, as indicated, for #interior# or #through lot# portions of #corner lots#, and for #zoning lots# bounded by two or more #streets# that are neither #corner lots# nor #through lots#, the portion of a #side lot line# beyond 100 feet of the #street line# that it intersects shall be considered a #rear lot line# and the following rules shall apply along such #rear lot line#:

(1) In all districts, a #rear yard# shall be provided in accordance with Section 23-342 (Rear yard requirements), where such #rear lot line# coincides with a #rear lot line# of an adjoining #zoning lot#.

(2) In R1 through R5 Districts, a #rear yard# with a minimum depth of five feet shall be provided where such #rear lot line# coincides with a #side lot line# of an adjoining #zoning lot#.

(3) In R6 through R12 Districts, no #rear yard# shall be required where such #rear lot line# coincides with a #side lot line# of an adjoining #zoning lot#.

(d) For zoning lots with multiple #rear lot lines#

In all districts, as indicated, for #zoning lots# with multiple #rear lot lines#, if a #rear yard# extends from a #rear lot line# away from the #street line# which is used to determine such #rear lot line#, the following rules shall apply along such #rear lot line#:

(1) In all districts, where any such #rear lot line# coincides with the #rear lot line# of an adjoining #zoning lot#, a #rear yard# shall be provided in accordance with Section 23-342 (Rear yard requirements).

(2) In R1 through R5 Districts, a #rear yard# with a minimum depth of five feet shall be provided where such #rear lot line# coincides with a #side lot line# of an adjoining #zoning lot#.

(3) In R6 through R12 Districts, no #rear yard# shall be required where such #rear lot line# coincides with a #side lot line# of an adjoining #zoning lot#.

(4) In all districts, for portions of #through lots# that have multiple #rear lot lines# and such portions are not subject to #interior lot# regulations, the #street line# bounding the #zoning lot# closest to such #rear lot line# shall be used to determine compliance with this Section.
verbatim_excerpt_composition: Verbatim blocks of the section body joined by blank lines, in page order: [0] the section number and title as displayed; [1] the district list; then each paragraph. A list item is written with the label the print/PDF render prints in front of it ((a), (b), ... for the outer list; (1), (2), ... for a nested list), followed by one space; an item's heading line and its text (separated by a double line break in the HTML) are separate blocks. Defined terms (bold italic in the HTML) are written #term#, exactly as the print/PDF render writes them, inner spacing included. Runs of whitespace and non-breaking spaces are written as one space and each block is trimmed; embedded figures (images whose alt text is an editor's caption, not Resolution text) are omitted; no word was changed.

notes: Captured as the governing-source candidate for the corner rear-yard waiver (ZR 23-344(a), Last Amended 12/5/2024). Lane A item A-02b encodes paragraph (a) for R6B ONLY (rule r6b-rear-yard-corner-waiver); paragraphs (b), (c) and (d) are carried here and not encoded.

Paragraph (a) states the waiver with two conditions: the area is within 100 feet of the point of intersection of two street lines, and those street lines intersect at an angle of 135 degrees or less. The 100-foot test is a geometric site fact the rule consumes as an input, never derives; the 135-degree comparison ('or less' = at most 135) is applied by the rule to a supplied angle.

The section modifies the rear yard requirements of Section 23-342 and the rear yard equivalent requirements of Section 23-343, neither of which is captured: where the waiver does not hold, the rear yard that applies is NOT determined by anything citing this snapshot.

Paragraph (c)(3) and (d)(3) ('In R6 through R12 Districts, no #rear yard# shall be required where such #rear lot line# coincides with a #side lot line# of an adjoining #zoning lot#.') are further R6-R12 waivers beyond 100 feet of a street line; they depend on lot-line relationships not modelled here and are not encoded.
Paragraph (b) ends without a period ('within 100 feet of such #street line#') in both the HTML and the PDF; the excerpt keeps it verbatim.
The section embeds five illustrative figures (corner lot; zoning lot bounded by two or more streets; multiple rear lot lines); they are omitted from the excerpt and nothing here relies on them.

DISTRICT SCOPE FOR R6B: the section's district list names 'R1 R2 R3 R4 R5 R6 R7 R8 R9 R10 R11 R12' but not R6B. ZR 11-25 (snapshot zr-11-25, 'District Designations Appended with Suffixes') states that all regulations applicable to a district designation apply to that designation appended with a suffix, except as otherwise set forth in express provisions, and that if a section lists an R4 District its provisions also apply to R4-1, R4A and R4B unless separate provisions for the suffixed districts are listed within the section. This section lists no separate provision for any suffixed R6 district, so its R6 provisions reach R6B through ZR 11-25 - a reading of 11-25, not an express naming of R6B, to be confirmed by the reviewer (Q12) together with 11-25's 'except as otherwise set forth in express provisions' caveat.

Sibling section titles visible in the captured page's navigation (titles only; their text was NOT captured and nothing here relies on it): 23-34 Rear Yard and Rear Yard Equivalent Requirements; 23-341 Permitted obstructions in required rear yards or rear yard equivalents; 23-342 Rear yard requirements; 23-343 Rear yard equivalent requirements; 23-38 Special Rules for Certain Areas; 23-72 (23-723 Yard modifications, Brooklyn Community District 12).
Nothing in this record is a Verified zoning determination. Verified requires a published rule with G6 qualified-human legal approval.
